name: Pegvisomant
summary: Prescription GH-receptor blocker for acromegaly; its appearance relevance is as the opposite of a GH booster, and it has no cosmetic studies.
lead: Pegvisomant, sold as Somavert, is a pegylated growth hormone (GH) analog that blocks the GH receptor.  It is approved in the US for acromegaly in patients who responded inadequately to surgery or radiation, or for whom those are unsuitable, with the treatment goal of normalizing IGF-1.

name: Bivamelagon
summary: Investigational oral MC4R agonist tested for hypothalamic obesity; no data in cosmetic use.
lead: Bivamelagon (also LB54640) is an investigational oral melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) agonist.  It is being studied in hypothalamic obesity, weight gain following damage to the hypothalamus, and is not an approved drug.

name: RM-718
summary: Experimental weekly MC4R agonist in early trials for rare obesity syndromes; no results or cosmetic data.
lead: RM-718 is an investigational melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) agonist developed by Rhythm, described as a weekly-dosed compound.  A phase 1/2 study of RM-718 in healthy subjects and in patients with MC4R pathway impairment, including hypothalamic obesity and Prader-Willi syndrome, began in March 2024 with 111 participants.

name: PL-8177
summary: Experimental oral MC1r peptide in trials for ulcerative colitis; not studied for tanning or appearance.
lead: PL-8177 is an investigational oral peptide agonist of the melanocortin 1 receptor (MC1r).  It has been studied for inflammatory conditions, not for tanning or pigmentation: preclinical work with PL-8177 and PL-8331 examined prevention and reversal of intestinal and ocular inflammation in animal models.

name: SHU-9119
summary: Lab melanocortin antagonist used in rodent appetite research; no human studies and no approved use.
lead: SHU-9119 (also written SHU9119) is a laboratory melanocortin receptor antagonist used in animal research on appetite and energy balance.  Studies in rats infused it into the brain's third ventricle as a tool to block melanocortin signaling, alongside the agonist alpha-MSH.

name: S-23
summary: An investigational nonsteroidal SARM developed as a male contraceptive candidate; no human trials are published and it appears as a gray-market research chemical.
lead: S-23 (also called Mastorin) is an investigational selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed by GTx, Inc. as a candidate male hormonal contraceptive. It is a nonsteroidal compound that binds the androgen receptor with higher affinity than the older SARM andarine.

name: S-40503
summary: A preclinical nonsteroidal SARM tested in rat osteoporosis models; known mainly from doping-control research, with no human efficacy data.
lead: S-40503 is a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) first described in 2003 as a compound developed to pursue tissue-selective androgen receptor activity. It bound the androgen receptor with nanomolar affinity, with preference for it among nuclear receptors, and was evaluated in rat models of osteoporosis against dihydrotestosterone.

name: LGD-2226
summary: An experimental quinolinone SARM studied in animals for muscle and bone; no human trials and sold only as a research chemical.
lead: LGD-2226 is an investigational, orally active, nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the quinolinone chemical class, reported in the medicinal chemistry literature in 2006 . It was characterised in animal studies as an androgen receptor agonist with anabolic effects on muscle and bone and comparatively smaller effects on prostate weight and luteinizing hormone than testosterone .

name: LGD-2941
summary: A discontinued quinolinone SARM with almost no public data and no human results.
lead: LGD-2941 (also LGD-122941) is a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the quinolinone class that was investigated for cachexia, hypogonadism and osteoporosis . Wikipedia reports that it is no longer being developed, and its Phase I trial was discontinued .

name: LGD-3303
summary: A Ligand Pharmaceuticals nonsteroidal SARM tested only in rats and horses; no human data.
lead: LGD-3303 is an investigational, orally available nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator developed by Ligand Pharmaceuticals, with a tricyclic pyrrolo[3,2-f]quinolin-7-one structure . Published work consists of animal and in vitro studies of its pharmacokinetics, muscle and bone effects and effects on sexual behaviour in female rats .

name: ACP-105
summary: A discontinued experimental SARM tested in rats and mice; no human trials, sold online as a research chemical.
lead: ACP-105 is an investigational nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) with partial agonist activity relative to testosterone, described in a 2009 Journal of Medicinal Chemistry paper . It was discovered through a high-throughput screen using receptor selection and amplification technology, and improved anabolic parameters in castrated male rats .

name: AC-262536
summary: An Acadia-developed experimental SARM with rat data and no human trials, sold online as a research chemical.
lead: AC-262,536 (also called Accadrine) is an investigational nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator developed by Acadia Pharmaceuticals, described in a 2008 pharmacological characterisation as a potent, selective androgen receptor ligand with partial agonist activity . In a 2-week study in castrated male rats it improved anabolic parameters .

name: BMS-564929
summary: A very potent Bristol-Myers Squibb SARM that stalled in early trials; rat data only.
lead: BMS-564929 (also PS-178990) is a potent, orally active, nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator developed by Bristol-Myers Squibb for age-related functional decline in men . A 2007 Endocrinology study reported a subnanomolar androgen receptor affinity, selectivity over other steroid receptors, and strong stimulation of skeletal muscle with comparatively little prostate stimulation in castrated rats .

name: GLPG0492
summary: Experimental non-steroidal SARM tested in mouse muscle-wasting models and phase 1 volunteer trials; no efficacy data in people.
lead: GLPG0492, also known as DT-200, is an experimental non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the diarylhydantoin chemical class. It was designed to promote muscle growth through the androgen receptor while having weaker effects on reproductive tissues such as the prostate, and it has been investigated for muscle-wasting conditions including sarcopenia, cachexia and muscular dystrophy.

name: TFM-4AS-1
summary: Laboratory steroidal SARM shown in rats to favor muscle and bone over reproductive tissue; never tested in people.
lead: TFM-4AS-1 is an experimental steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) described in a 2009 paper in the Journal of Biological Chemistry. It belongs to the 4-aza-steroid class and was characterized as a potent androgen receptor ligand that only partially activates the receptor.

name: MK-0773
summary: Steroidal SARM that added lean mass in frail older women but did not improve strength or function in a phase 2 trial.
lead: MK-0773, also known as PF-05314882, is an experimental steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) that was developed to increase muscle mass and strength while minimizing effects on other tissues. It was tested in clinical trials for sarcopenia, the age-related loss of muscle mass and function.

name: GSK2881078
summary: Pharma-developed SARM that raised lean mass in older adults and leg strength in men with COPD, at the cost of lower HDL and transient liver-enzyme rises.
lead: GSK2881078 is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed by GlaxoSmithKline for muscle weakness associated with chronic and acute illness. It has been tested in phase 1 and phase 2 trials, including studies in healthy older adults and in people with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

name: OPK-88004
summary: Investigational SARM that raised lean mass and cut fat in prostate cancer survivors without improving symptoms or performance.
lead: OPK-88004, also known as LY-2452473, is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). It has been studied for androgen deficiency symptoms in prostate cancer survivors and for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).

name: MK-3984
summary: Obscure SARM candidate with no human data; known mainly from a doping-control metabolite study.
lead: MK-3984 is an experimental selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) targeting muscle and bone tissue. Very little published information exists: it is mentioned in the SARM literature  and has been the subject of a 2026 doping-control study of its metabolism in zebrafish.

name: Arcarine
summary: Orion's discontinued SARM candidate; reached Phase I and left almost no public data on muscle or looks.
lead: Arcarine (development code ORM-11984) is an investigational selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed by the Finnish company Orion Corporation. SARMs are drugs designed to activate the androgen receptor in some tissues, such as muscle and bone, more than in others, such as the prostate .

name: GSK-971086
summary: A discontinued GSK indole-class SARM that never got past Phase I; no efficacy data exist.
lead: GSK-971086 (also written GSK971086) is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) from the indole chemical class, developed by GlaxoSmithKline and investigated for sarcopenia (age-related muscle loss) and androgen deficiency .

name: GSK-2849466
summary: A GSK SARM candidate for cachexia that stopped after one small Phase I trial.
lead: GSK-2849466 (GSK2849466) is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the N-arylhydroxyalkyl class, developed by GlaxoSmithKline and investigated for cachexia and heart failure .

name: GTx-027
summary: A SARM candidate explored for breast cancer and incontinence; essentially preclinical, with nothing on looks.
lead: GTx-027 is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the arylpropionamide class, associated with GTx, Inc. and investigated for breast cancer and stress urinary incontinence . Wikipedia lists its status as Phase I, discontinued, or preclinical .

name: LY305
summary: A skin-applied SARM built for low testosterone; interesting pharmacology, no appearance data.
lead: LY305 is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the N-arylhydroxyalkyl class, developed as a transdermal (through-the-skin) treatment for hypogonadism, and also explored for muscle wasting and osteoporosis .

name: PF-06260414
summary: Pfizer's oral SARM for cachexia; safety-tested in healthy men, then shelved.
lead: PF-06260414 is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the isoquinoline class, developed by Pfizer and investigated for cachexia; development was discontinued after Phase I .

name: JNJ-26146900
summary: A Johnson & Johnson SARM tested only in rats for prostate cancer; never given to humans.
lead: JNJ-26146900 is an experimental nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed by Johnson & Johnson, investigated as a possible prostate cancer treatment. It has never been marketed and, according to Wikipedia, was never tested in humans.

name: RU-59063
summary: A 1990s research androgen-receptor ligand that became a template for later antiandrogens; no human use.
lead: RU-59063 is an experimental nonsteroidal androgen, sometimes classed as a SARM, first described in 1994. It was never marketed and has no clinical use.

name: Bolandiol
summary: A nandrolone-related steroid with mixed androgen, estrogen and progestin activity; studied in rats, never marketed as a base.
lead: Bolandiol (19-nor-4-androstenediol, estr-4-ene-3beta,17beta-diol) is a synthetic anabolic-androgenic steroid related to nandrolone. The base compound was never marketed, though its dipropionate ester (anabiol) has been sold. The World Anti-Doping Agency lists it as prohibited.

name: Dienolone
summary: A never-marketed nandrolone-like steroid, mainly of interest as a chemical intermediate.
lead: Dienolone (also nordienolone, RU-3118, trenazone, dienazone) is a synthetic anabolic-androgenic steroid of the 19-nortestosterone group. It was developed under the code RU-3118 and never marketed.

name: Norclostebol
summary: A 1950s chlorinated nandrolone derivative with no listed medical use and no human studies.
lead: Norclostebol (4-chloro-19-nortestosterone) is a synthetic anabolic-androgenic steroid derived from nandrolone, sold under names such as Lentabol; its acetate ester has been sold as Anabol 4-19. It was described in the literature in 1957.
